comment: VACATION-PREP domain slice: the changes that land while the family is gone.
Dates are day_offsets from IClock.Today (generic-clock rule). pending_updates
mirrors the guests.json shape: each carries an activation_day_offset and
surfaces when the simulated week reaches it. Seeded with one believable material
change — a delivery arriving to an empty house — so vacation prep has an
adaptation beat, not just a static plan.
v6 — THE AWAY WINDOW IS NOT HERE ANY MORE. It used to sit in this file as
observer only ever consumed pending_updates. It is now POLICY — it arrives on the
dispatch as constraints.hard.away_window (ISO dates), where the date_window_block
rule enforces it, so an appliance run scheduled into the empty house is blocked
rather than merely discouraged. Two copies of the trip dates would only be a way
for the enforced window and the planned one to disagree.

pending_updates.description: A parcel delivery is scheduled while the house is empty
